title: BLESSED ARE THE PEACEMAKER
theme: Jesus makes peace between God and humanity and calls His followers to peacemaking as God’s children.
proposition: As children of God, we should follow Jesus in bringing peace between people and God and between one another.
sermonQuestion: Why are peacemakers called the children of God?

outline.heading: JESUS CAME TO BRING PEACE BETWEEN GOD AND MAN.
JESUS CAME TO BRING PEACE BETWEEN MAN AND MAN
PEACEMAKERS ARE CALLED THE CHILDREN OF GOD
